description.value: Connie's Cook House is a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant on Vancouver's West 4th Avenue, serving Szechuan, Cantonese, and Malaysian curry dishes known for generous portions. The restaurant offers online ordering for pickup as well as free local delivery, and caters to parties of all sizes. Gluten-free options are available and all dishes are prepared with pure vegetable oil.
